review_candidates.description: Hey there! We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment. Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment. Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences. Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right? To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment! Ready to be part of the experience? Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission. Behind the user-friendly iOS and Android apps and webpage that work across the world is the engineering team. We are in charge of creating, developing, improving, and maintaining all Fever services so that more people can have an amazing experience. Location: This position is based in Madrid. Frequent travel to France will be required to support collaboration with local teams and stakeholders. About The Role We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our Infrastructure & Platform team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and operating highly available, scalable, and secure infrastructure solutions across AWS cloud environments and on-premise datacenters. You will play a key role in driving the evolution of our hybrid cloud strategy, ensuring seamless integration between cloud and on-premise systems while supporting business-critical services at scale. This position combines deep expertise in cloud infrastructure, networking, storage, virtualization, automation, and operational excellence. As a senior member of the team, you will contribute to infrastructure architecture, mentor engineers, lead technical initiatives, and collaborate closely with Platform Engineering, Security, DevOps, and Software Engineering teams. This role is ideal for experienced infrastructure professionals who enjoy working across both cloud-native and traditional enterprise environments, combining hands-on technical work with architectural ownership and technical leadership. What You'll Do Design, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable, and resilient infrastructure across on-premise environments and AWS. Lead the implementation and optimization of hybrid cloud architectures. Manage and optimize AWS services including EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, RDS, Route 53, CloudFront, ECS, EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, and Step Functions. Design and operate secure connectivity solutions between cloud and datacenter environments using AWS Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPNs, and VPC Peering. Manage Linux and Windows-based infrastructure platforms and associated services. Administer virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere, ESXi, Hyper-V, or KVM. Manage enterprise storage environments, including NetApp solutions, backup, replication, and disaster recovery strategies. Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation. Develop automation and operational tooling using Python, Bash, and PowerShell. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support infrastructure and platform deployments. Monitor, troubleshoot, and continuously improve infrastructure performance, reliability, and security. Support cloud migration initiatives and workload modernization projects. Drive infrastructure governance, standards, and best practices across the organization. Collaborate with Security teams to ensure compliance with security and regulatory requirements. Participate in architectural reviews and contribute to long-term infrastructure strategy. Mentor junior engineers and promote a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and knowledge sharing. Produce and maintain technical documentation in English. About You You are an experienced infrastructure professional with a cloud background and a passion for building reliable, secure, and scalable systems. You enjoy solving complex technical challenges, balancing operational excellence with strategic thinking, and collaborating with stakeholders across multiple teams and geographies. You are comfortable taking ownership of critical infrastructure initiatives while helping others grow through mentorship and technical leadership Requirements Language Requirements English: Professional working proficiency (B2 or higher) – Mandatory. Spanish: Native or full professional proficiency (C1 or higher) – Mandatory. Strong written and verbal communication skills for collaborating with global, multicultural teams. Experience & Availability 5+ years of hands-on experience in systems and infrastructure engineering. 2+ years in production environments using cloud preferably AWS. Proven track record designing, building, and maintaining hybrid cloud architectures (preferably AWS + On-Premise integration). Basic Hands-on experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters in production environments. Basic experience operating in international, distributed, and cross-functional teams. You must reside in Madrid. Availability to travel: Occasional travel required to physical data centers for hardware management, maintenance, or infrastructure projects. Basic AWS Technical Skills (Must Have) Core Services: EC2, VPC, S3, IAM, RDS, Route 53, ELB/ALB. Networking & Connectivity: Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Site-to-Site VPN, VPC Peering. Basic AWS Technical Skills (Nice To Have) Container Orchestration: Amazon EKS (cluster setup, node groups, ingress, security, scale management) and ECS. CDN: CloudFront or Cloudflare Identity & Governance: IAM policies, AWS IAM Identity Center (SSO), AWS Organizations. Observability: CloudWatch, CloudTrail, AWS Config. Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced Terraform or CloudFormation. Serverless: Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions. On-Premise & Datacenter Technical Skills (Must Have) OS Administration: Linux (RHEL, Ubuntu) and Windows Server. Virtualization: VMware vSphere/ESXi, Hyper-V, or KVM. Datacenter & Hardware: Physical server maintenance, rack management, datacenter operations, and operator room management. Networking: TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VLANs, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, LDAP. On-Premise & Datacenter Technical Skills (Nice To Have) Kubernetes & Containerization: Production management of self-hosted or bare-metal Kubernetes clusters (RKE, OpenShift, K3s, microK8s, or upstream Kubernetes), Docker, and Containerd. Storage & Backup (NetApp Ecosystem): SAN/NAS (iSCSI, NFS), ONTAP, SnapMirror, SnapVault, SnapCenter, BlueXP, Cloud Volumes ONTAP, FabricPool cloud tiering, or other persistent storage management for Kubernetes and Linux (NetApp Astra Trident / CSI drivers). Firewalling: Iptables, Pfsense, Fortinet or any other Firewall Appliance. WAF: AWS WAF, Cloudflare, Datodome or Imperva. Basic Hybrid Architecture & Migration knowledge: Architecting secure, high-availability hybrid connections. Workload migration strategies (Lift-and-Shift, Re-platforming, Re-architecting). Capacity planning, performance tuning, and cross-environment cost optimization. DevOps, Automation & Security (Nice to have) Container Ecosystem & Tooling: Helm, Kustomize, Ingress Controllers (Nginx, Traefik), Cert-Manager. Scripting & Automation: Python, Bash, Ansible. CI/CD & Version Control: Git, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline. Monitoring & Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or Splunk. Security & Compliance: Security hardening best practices, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and GDPR awareness. Soft Skills Strong architectural vision, analytical problem-solving, and technical decision-making. Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Proactive mindset with autonomous execution in distributed setups. Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing mindset. Nice to Have AWS Certifications: Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional), SysOps Administrator, or DevOps Engineer. Kubernetes Certifications: CKA, CKAD, or CKS. Hands-on experience with Multi-Cloud setups (Azure or GCP). GitOps practices and continuous deployment tools (ArgoCD, Flux). Education Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related engineering field (or equivalent hands-on experience). Benefits & Perks 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences. Home office friendly anywhere in Spain. Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth. Great work environment with a young, diverse team of talented people to work with! Health insurance and other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee's platform. English Lessons. Gympass Membership. Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary through Payflow. Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance. Total Compensation: 65-75k (Including Base and Variable) About The Process Fever aims to provide the best-fastest possible experience to our candidates. This is how it would look like: Talent Interview - 1h: An intro to Fever, our culture and a conversation about your background and experience. Technical Assignment: Your opportunity to demonstrate all you know! We would like to receive it back within 7 days. Team Interview - 1.5h: A discussion about your proposed solution to the technical challenge. And your opportunity to ask anything you need to know about your day to day at Fever. Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you! If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | Tech.Eu |TechCrunch Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply! If you require any kind of accommodation during the selection process please contact our Talent team so we can help you by providing a welcoming and seamless journey.
